title: Network Penetration
sensory_anchor: a cursor blinking in a terminal, the hum of a server rack, the particular cold of a data center
emotional_signature: the digital room is still a room, and she still maps it
body: The network. A target's infrastructure. She maps it the way she maps every room. a cursor blinking in a terminal, the hum of a server rack, the particular cold of a data center. The entry point is a service left running. The service is a door that was not closed. She walks through. The target does not know. the digital room is still a room, and she still maps it.
